about: One loop per stage type: which phases a stage has and what each phase must produce. It never says HOW a phase is done (tools, sessions, plugins): that is decided outside Blueprint when the stage opens. Read by the create-plan skill, the stage-opening step and the plan-guard hook. Claude never edits this file.

phases.when: a decision depends on something nobody knows yet (cost, feasibility, access)
phases.produces: the missing information, e.g. a throwaway mockup or test
one combined proposal with the rejected alternatives
a choice; the user makes the hard-to-change ones
the decision written down (vault or context card)

discussion.done_when: every topic has a written decision or is postponed with a reason

implementation.purpose: Build and verify one or more parts.

phases.when: the stage touches the foundations or decisions are missing
phases.produces: the missing decisions
the implementation plan
the parts built
green tests
review passed

phases.when: the work must be merged into a main line
phases.produces: work merged

implementation.done_when: green tests, review passed, work merged if planned

verification.purpose: Check something that already exists (user test, load, security, accessibility).

phases.produces: what is checked and what 'passed' means
the result of the check
the outcome shown to the user
the problem fixed, or a new stage proposed in the plan

verification.done_when: every topic has an outcome; negative ones are fixed or became stages

delivery.purpose: Show the work to someone: demo, presentation, document.

phases.produces: what is delivered, consistent with the written decisions
a full run-through done; a plan B if needed
delivered
the feedback recorded as notes or as proposed plan changes

quick_task.purpose: A short job of any nature: a mini discussion, a small implementation, a mockup, a check.

phases.produces: the job done
the result verified
the result in a few lines; if something changes, a proposed plan change
